title: LightCarbon LCRXS-V road caliper frame with integrated-routing stem
notes: Exact page identifies LCRXS-V and lists Toray T700, five size-specific frame weights, 405 g fork, 28C maximum, BB86, direct-mount rim brakes, geometry, ISO4210 and two-year warranty. Its HBR05/HBR07 cockpit rows conflict, so the exact included cockpit is unresolved.
